name: fast-jev-compaction-codex
description: Jev-selected tool evidence preserved around native Codex compaction on Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve Jev-selected evidence after native compaction
interface.longDescription: Windows adaptation of fast-jev-compaction. Selects tool evidence before native compaction and adds bounded quoted evidence afterwards. Requires TYPESAFE_API_KEY and Codex hook trust.
